description.text: Program Description The curriculum system and knowledge structure of this major reflect the professional basic theory of information science and computer science on the basis of solid mathematics. By information theory, scientific computing, the respect such as operations research knowledge education and establish the basis of mathematical model, the mathematical practice class, professional practice each link of training, trains the student to solve the scientific computing, software development and design, information processing and coding, actual problem ability, cultivate qualified for information processing, work by the department of science and engineering calculation. Duration 4 years

duration.text: The Information and Computing Science at Beijing Jiaotong University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3055 USD/per year ￥ 22000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 6. Financial guarantee letter Photocopy of the signatured financial guarantee letter from his/her financial guarantor to prove their solvency.

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 2. High school graduate 3. Be in good health condition and above the age of 18
